evals.prompt: Using legal-document-redactor in ai mode, redact examples/fictional sample contract DOCX with entities_ai.json. Residual scan must pass and party names must be gone.
evals.expected: same-format docx, ledger in ~/.legal-redactor/ledgers, no raw mobile/id/case number

evals.prompt: Using production mode on the same fiction, keep 郝测一 and company names, strip phones and ID.
evals.expected: parties remain, structural contacts removed, residual pass

evals.prompt: Redact a complaint citing 《中华人民共和国著作权法》第十条 and the work 《星河测例》 in ai mode.
evals.expected: statute title kept verbatim; 《星河测例》 replaced with 某作品

evals.prompt: Redact a judgment mentioning 最高人民法院 and 北京互联网法院 in ai mode.
evals.expected: court names unchanged (default allowlist)

evals.prompt: A document contains 订单号 1234567890123456 (fails Luhn, no account label). Redact in ai mode.
evals.expected: order number kept; listed in suspects as low-confidence; verify status WARN not FAIL

evals.prompt: Redact 收款账户：6222 0212 3456 7894 in production mode.
evals.expected: account replaced with [账号]

evals.prompt: Redact text with 编号 91110105MA01ABCDE8 (bad checksum, no 信用代码 label).
evals.expected: value kept and flagged in suspects, not auto-replaced

evals.prompt: Redact （2025）京73民终678号 in ai mode.
evals.expected: replacement keeps 民终 stage: （20XX）X民终X号

evals.prompt: Redact 法定代表人李测强，住所地… in ai mode with --auto-confident.
evals.expected: 李测强 replaced with 某X alias

evals.prompt: Production-mode redaction of 车牌京A12345 and 京(2023)朝阳区不动产权第0012345号.
evals.expected: both replaced per 法释〔2016〕19号; birth date kept

evals.prompt: Use --profile publish on a complaint for a public case write-up.
evals.expected: public rewrite, not a court-publication copy: person aliases in 张某 style; addresses truncated to 县/区; amounts fuzzed; judge names kept

evals.prompt: Redact a judgment with --mode ai. The caption contains 审判长 赵测审.
evals.expected: 赵测审 replaced. production, publish and judgment-online keep that name

evals.prompt: Use --profile judgment-online on a copyright judgment. A minor is listed in entities.json with role article8. The text also has a labelled address, a mobile, a USCC, a birth date and the presiding judge.
evals.expected: party name, birth date, USCC and judge kept; address truncated to district; mobile removed; article8 person becomes 张某; an ordinary party is not renamed

evals.prompt: Use --profile minimal: only ID, mobile, email, bank account.
evals.expected: names, case number, landline, plate untouched; ID/mobile/email/account replaced

evals.prompt: After ai-mode redaction, restore an online-AI reply containing 某甲 and 某单位A using the local ledger.
evals.expected: legal-redactor restore writes original names back; ambiguous tokens warned

evals.prompt: Run a default redact and check where the ledger lands.
evals.expected: ledger under ~/.legal-redactor/ledgers/<hash>/ with 0600; only a pointer file beside output

evals.prompt: Redact with --ledger-encrypt and LEGAL_REDACTOR_LEDGER_PASS set; then restore.
evals.expected: ledger.json.enc written, no plaintext ledger; restore works with the same password

evals.prompt: Redact a complaint and open *.audit.md.
evals.expected: per-replacement category/confidence/rule/paragraph/context; residual risk section; status PASS/WARN/FAIL

evals.prompt: Run verify on (a) clean output (b) output with an order number (c) original source.
evals.expected: PASS exit 0; WARN exit 0 (1 with --strict); FAIL exit 2

evals.prompt: Redact a docx whose app.xml has Company and comments have authors.
evals.expected: Company/Manager cleared, authors normalized to 作者, rsid stripped

evals.prompt: Redact a docx containing an infringing-URL hyperlink as evidence with --preserve-hyperlinks.
evals.expected: external hyperlink targets kept

evals.prompt: In ai mode with --auto-confident, redact a judgment whose body says 原告X有限公司（以下简称X公司）与被告Y有限公司（以下简称Y公司）… and 被告Y有限公司于本判决生效之日起十日内赔偿原告X有限公司经济损失.
evals.expected: both full names and both unquoted short names replaced; the operative clause text (于本判决生效之日起十日内赔偿原告 / 经济损失) unchanged

evals.prompt: Redact 证人王测娟出庭作证称…其表弟周测川实际运营。第三人陈述，被告明知… in ai mode with --auto-confident.
evals.expected: 王测娟 and 周测川 replaced; 陈述 / 明知 / 经济损失 never treated as names

evals.prompt: Run verify --mode ai --strict on an ai output that still contains a party company name.
evals.expected: exit 1 (WARN) with the company listed as nl_residual; exit 0 once it is in --allowlist or replaced

evals.prompt: Redact a docx where Word split a name across runs next to a bold label (被告：| 陈 | 测国).
evals.expected: name replaced; 被告： stays bold, the rest of the paragraph does not become bold
